industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: PannErgy Nyrt.
summary: PannErgy Nyrt. generates thermal and electric power through the exploitation of geothermal water resources. It operates through central heating and power plants located in Miskolc, Szentlorinc, Berekfürdo, and Gyor of Hungary. The company was founded in 1922 and is based in Budapest, Hungary.
